story_sequence.text: Program-level governance resolves a lake to the aggregation branch from program/lake topology when `git-workflow-*.md` is absent.
Program-level governance still resolves through explicit `git-workflow-*.md` when present.
`beacon qa run <lake>` accepts the aggregation branch after workspace admission and does not block with `branch_alignment_required`.
Repos without program-level contract/topology continue to resolve `beacon/<version>/<feature-slug>`.
Soft admission still blocks wrong current branch with `branch_alignment_required` using the shared resolved target.
